name: Tonic | 10mg Beverage | Fizz Lemon Lime 5:1
description:
50mg CBD : 10mg THC Beverage

Refresh your senses with Tonic Fizz 5:1 Lemon Lime. Infused with 10mg of premium cannabis extract in a 5:1 CBD to THC ratio, this sparkling beverage offers a mild and balanced experience. The crisp lemon-lime flavor provides a zesty and invigorating twist, perfect for relaxation, easing stress, or enhancing social moments. Enjoy this bubbly treat for a refreshing and calming cannabis experience.
